Haemorrhagic stroke: control blood pressure, reverse anticoagulation, treat raised intracranial pressure, and refer for neurosurgery if indicated.

qs.q: Progressive brain edema with rising intracranial pressure can cause
qs.e: Rising intracranial pressure can compress cerebral vessels, reduce cerebral perfusion pressure and produce ischemia. Severe edema can therefore create a dangerous cycle of impaired perfusion and further injury.
